title: reading-pipeline: answer its provider notice ai-accounts:124, consolidate its requirements file under the cap, and meet any unmet mark

Alternative if you prefer no new module: rule that the R44 text and the R28/R23 amendment line may be rewritten as a proper R44 line, and that Uses/Satisfies may move to notes; it still lands near 70,000 with no headroom, so I recommend the split.
